modeling_decisions: C concept mixed debris retained; strengthen its weak arc into a single obvious broad crescent ridge convex toward-Y/down-valley. High broad central ridge at y=-6, arms curve toward+Y at sides. Interior+Y floor low and enclosed only across front/sides; rear+Y open valley direction. Scatter embedded varied angular stones along actual crest and flanks, not scenic mountain backdrop. No lake/ice, no esker serpentine.
